svg.title: copilot-learn architecture
svg.desc: The claude-learn loop mapped onto the GitHub Copilot harness, with optional Harvest and Time tracking plug-ins and four on-demand gates.
svg.text: next session starts from what this one learned
Live context: the default, reflect on it directly
Rebuild the timeline from live context or the transcript
Signals: corrections, retries, hand-fixed output, missing handoffs
Recurs in 3+ sessions: treat it as systemic
One Pattern + Rule entry per learning
Copilot Memory adds cited repo facts, expiring after 28 days
Worth-authoring gate: 5 checks, else it stays a lesson
Narrow rules go to applyTo-scoped *.instructions.md files
skills/, agents/, prompts/ plus AGENTS.md at the root
Two-way converge every skill the session touched
Copilot also reads .claude/skills: one tree serves both harnesses
Back up global before any write
hook in after Reconcile, only when a session calls for it
Fixed steps, checkable output, proven once, will recur
Script it: explicit flags, dry-run, idempotent re-runs
Assertable summary line, logged in the harvest registry
Window from hook timestamps and file evidence
Split at midnight, never bill one minute twice
Import once, at the real end: imported rows are immutable
Outside the loop: periodic hygiene for the skill library and the instruction surface.
Read every line and every script
Merge per file, rows must resolve
Sources: Microsoft Learn and GitHub Docs. The session-state format is undocumented and can change.
